{"correlation":"# Check if the process has already been added to the Browser_Pivoting TL
query Check_Process($host, $process_name, $process_id, $beacon_name, $beacon_id) from Browser_Pivoting {
    host == $host
    and browser_process == $process_name
    and browser_process_id == $process_id
    and beacon_name == $beacon_name
    and beacon_id == $beacon_id
}
query Check_Process_Without_Port($host, $process_name, $process_id, $beacon_name, $beacon_id) from Browser_Pivoting {
    host == $host
    and browser_process == $process_name
    and browser_process_id == $process_id
    and beacon_name == $beacon_name
    and beacon_id == $beacon_id
    and proxy_port == null  # Allows to find incomplete records
}
query Get_Process($host, $process_name, $process_id, $beacon_name, $beacon_id, $user) from Browser_Pivoting {
    host == $host
    and browser_process == $process_name
    and browser_process_id == $process_id
    and beacon_name == $beacon_name
    and beacon_id == $beacon_id
    and username == $user
    and proxy_port == null  # Allows to find incomplete records
}
    qhandler {
        $host = host
        $browser_process = browser_process
        $browser_pid = browser_process_id
        $beacon_name = beacon_name
        $beacon_id = beacon_id
        $user = username
    }
event Inject_Into_IE:
    key:
        event_src.host, object.process.fullpath, subject.account.name
    filter {
        filter::NotFromCorrelator()
        and event_src.title == "sysmon"
        and msgid == "8"
        and in_list(["msedge.exe", "iexplore.exe"], object.process.name)
        and filter::CheckWL_Process_Access("Cobalt_Strike_Browserpivot", lower(join([subject.account.name, subject.process.fullpath, object.process.fullpath], "|")))
    }
event Load_DLL:
    key:
        event_src.host, subject.process.fullpath, subject.account.name
    filter {
        filter::NotFromCorrelator()
        and event_src.title == "sysmon"
        and msgid == "7"
        and in_list(["msedge.exe", "iexplore.exe"], subject.process.name)
        and lower(object.process.name) == "wininet.dll"  
    }
event IMarshal:
    key:
        event_src.host, object.process.fullpath, subject.account.name, dst.port
    filter {
        correlation_name == "Subrule_IMarshal_Interface"
        and src.port == dst.port
        and filter::Loopback_Address(src.ip)
        and filter::Loopback_Address(dst.ip)
        and exec_query("Check_Process_Without_Port", [lower(event_src.host), lower(subject.process.name), lower(subject.process.id), lower(object.process.name), object.process.id])
        and filter::CheckWL_Networking("Cobalt_Strike_Browserpivot", lower(join([subject.account.name, subject.process.fullpath, object.process.fullpath, string(dst.port)], "|")))
    }
event Possible_Proxy:
    key: 
        event_src.host, object.process.fullpath, object.account.name, datafield8
    filter {
        correlation_name == "Subrule_Possible_Proxy_Usage"
    }                
rule Cobalt_Strike_Browserpivot: (
        ((Inject_Into_IE and Load_DLL) timer 10s)
        or ((IMarshal+ and Possible_Proxy+) timer 6m)
    )
    init {
        $labels = "w_auto"
        $already_detected_browser = false
        $first_event_imarshal = true
        $first_event_tunnel = true
    }
    on Inject_Into_IE {
        $subject = subject  # process
        $action = action    # start
        $object = object    # thread
        $status = status    # success
        copy_fields($subject.account, subject.account)
        $subject.process.id = subject.process.id
        $subject.process.name = subject.process.name
        $subject.process.path = subject.process.path
        $subject.process.fullpath = subject.process.fullpath
        $subject.process.guid = subject.process.guid
        copy_fields($object.account, object.account)
        $object.process.id = object.process.id
        $object.process.name = object.process.name
        $object.process.path = object.process.path
        $object.process.fullpath = object.process.fullpath
        $object.process.guid = object.process.guid
        $object.property = object.property
        $object.value = object.value
        $datafield6 = datafield6  # Starting address of the thread
        copy_fields($event_src, event_src)
        $reason = "Code injection into browser process"
        
        $alert.key = lower(join([subject.account.name, subject.process.fullpath, object.process.fullpath], "|"))
        if exec_query("Check_Process", [lower($event_src.host), lower($object.process.name), $object.process.id, lower($subject.process.name), lower($subject.process.id)]) then
            $already_detected_browser = true
        endif
        $labels = join([$labels, "CheckWL_Process_Access"], "|")
    }
    on IMarshal {
        if $first_event_imarshal then
            $subject.account.id = subject.account.id
            $subject.account.name = subject.account.name
            $subject.account.domain = subject.account.domain
            
            $subject.process.id = subject.process.id
            $subject.process.name = subject.process.name
            $subject.process.path = subject.process.path
            $subject.process.fullpath = subject.process.fullpath
            $subject.process.guid = subject.process.guid
            $object.account.id = object.account.id
            $object.account.name = object.account.name
            $object.account.domain = object.account.domain
            $object.process.id = object.process.id
            $object.process.name = object.process.name
            $object.process.path = object.process.path
            $object.process.fullpath = object.process.fullpath
            $object.property = object.property
            $object.value = object.value
            
            $src.port = src.port
            $protocol = protocol
            copy_fields($event_src, event_src)
            $reason = "Pivoting"
            $alert.key = lower(join([subject.account.name, subject.process.fullpath, object.process.fullpath, string(dst.port)], "|"))
            $result = exec_query("Get_Process", [lower(event_src.host), lower(subject.process.name), lower(subject.process.id), lower(object.process.name), lower(object.process.id), lower(subject.account.name)])
            $labels = join([$labels, "CheckWL_Networking"], "|")
            $first_event_imarshal = false
        endif    
    }
    on Possible_Proxy {
        if $first_event_tunnel then
            $subject = subject  # rule
            $action = action    # allow, detect
            $object = object    # connection
            $status = status    # success
            copy_fields($dst, dst)
            $first_event_tunnel = false
        endif
    }
emit {
    $correlation_type = "incident"
    $importance = "medium"
    $category.generic = "Attack"
    $category.high = "Command and Control"
    $category.low = "Proxy: Internal Proxy"
    switch $reason
        case "Code injection into browser process"
            $incident.aggregation.key = join([$correlation_name, $event_src.host, lower($subject.process.name)], "|")
        case "Pivoting"
            $incident.aggregation.key = join([$correlation_name, $event_src.host, lower($object.process.name)], "|")
    endswitch
    $incident.severity = $importance
    $incident.category = "HostOrSoftCompromising"
    $incident.aggregation.timeout = 2h
}
insert_into Browser_Pivoting if ($reason == "Code injection into browser process" and $already_detected_browser == false) {
    host = lower($event_src.host)
    browser_process = lower($object.process.name)
    browser_process_id = lower($object.process.id)
    beacon_name = lower($subject.process.name)
    beacon_id = lower($subject.process.id)
    username = lower($subject.account.name)
}
insert_into Browser_Pivoting if ($reason == "Pivoting") {
    host = $result["$host"]
    browser_process = $result["$browser_process"]
    browser_process_id = $result["$browser_pid"]
    beacon_name = $result["$beacon_name"]
    beacon_id = $result["$beacon_id"]
    username = $result["$user"]
    proxy_port = $src.port
    possible_c2_server = $dst.host
}","description":""}

{"correlation":"query Check_DMSA($dmsa) from Account_Linked_To_DMSA {
    dmsa_name == $dmsa
    or dmsa_dn == $dmsa
}

query Get_DMSA($dmsa) from Account_Linked_To_DMSA {
    dmsa_name == $dmsa
}
    qhandler {
        $dmsa_dn = dmsa_dn
        $target_dn = target_dn
        $target_name = target_name
        $target_domain = target_domain
        $target_id = target_id
        $count = count()
    }


event DMSA_Modify:
    key:
        event_src.host, object.fullpath
    filter {
        correlation_name == "Subrule_BadSuccessor_Attack"
        and filter::CheckWL_Specific_Only("BadSuccessor_Attack", lower(join([subject.account.name, object.fullpath, object.value], "|")))
    }


event DMSA_Migration_Complete:
    key:
        event_src.host, object.fullpath
    filter {
        filter::NotFromCorrelator()
        and event_src.title == "active_directory"
        and msgid == "5136"
        and object.state == "value added"
        and lower(object.property)== "msds-delegatedmsastate"
        and object.value == "2"
    }


event DMSA_Remove_Quickly:
    key:
        event_src.host, object.fullpath
    filter {
        filter::NotFromCorrelator()
        and event_src.title == "active_directory"
        and msgid == "5141"
        and lower(object.type) == "msds-delegatedmanagedserviceaccount"
        and (datetime_to_epoch(time) - datetime_to_epoch(select_query_first("Check_DMSA", [lower(object.fullpath)], "_last_changed"))) < 86400  # 24h
        and filter::CheckWL_Specific_Only("BadSuccessor_Attack", lower(join([subject.account.name, object.fullpath], "|")))
    }


event Malicious_DMSA_Ticket_Request:
    key: 
        src.ip, subject.account.name
    filter {
        filter::NotFromCorrelator()
        and event_src.title == "windows"
        and msgid == "4769"
        and status == "success"
        and not filter::Loopback_Address(src.ip)
        and lower(src.host) != "localhost"
        and match(subject.account.name, "*$")
        and exec_query("Check_DMSA", [lower(subject.account.name)])
        and filter::CheckWL_Windows_Login("BadSuccessor_Attack", lower(join([src.ip, subject.account.name], "|")))
    }


rule BadSuccessor_Attack: ((DMSA_Modify and DMSA_Migration_Complete?) timer 30s) or (Malicious_DMSA_Ticket_Request+ timer 5m) or DMSA_Remove_Quickly

    init {
        $labels = "w_auto"
        $count.subevents = 0
        $target_services = []
    }

    on DMSA_Modify {
        $subject = subject  # account
        $action = action    # modify
        $object = object    # ds_object
        $status = status    # success

        copy_fields($subject.account, subject.account)

        copy_fields($object.account, object.account)

        $object.name = object.name
        $object.fullpath = object.fullpath
        $object.type = object.type
        $object.property = object.property
        $object.value = object.value
        $object.id = object.id
        $object.state = object.state

        copy_fields($event_src, event_src)

        if $reason == null then
            $reason = "target account linked"
        endif

        $alert.key = lower(join([subject.account.name, object.fullpath, object.value], "|"))
        $alert.context = join(remove([$alert.context, alert.context], null), " | ")

        $labels = join([$labels, "CheckWL_Specific_Only"], "|")

        $count.subevents = $count.subevents + count.subevents
    }

    on DMSA_Migration_Complete {
        $reason = "target account linked and migration completed"

        $alert.context = join(remove([$alert.context, "migration completed"], null), " | ")

        $count.subevents = $count.subevents + 1
    }

    on Malicious_DMSA_Ticket_Request {
        if $count.subevents == 0 then
            $subject = subject  # account
            $action = action    # access
            $object = object    # system
            $status = status    # success

            copy_fields($subject.account, subject.account)

            copy_fields($src, src)

            $logon_service = logon_service  # Service name to which the ticket was issued

            $datafield2 = datafield2  # Ticket encryption type
            $datafield4 = datafield4  # Description of completion status
            $datafield5 = datafield5  # Subject session identifier in GUID format
            $datafield6 = datafield6  # Description of ticket encryption type
            $datafield8 = datafield8  # Ticket property flags in hexadecimal format

            copy_fields($event_src, event_src)

            $reason = "ticket requested"

            $alert.key = lower(join([src.ip, subject.account.name], "|"))

            $data = exec_query("Get_DMSA", [lower(subject.account.name)])

            $numfield1 = $data["$count"]

            if $numfield1 == 1 then
                if $data["$target_name"] != null then
                    $alert.context = join(["target privileges", $data["$target_dn"]], ": ")

                    $object.account.name = $data["$target_name"]
                    $object.account.domain = $data["$target_domain"]
                    $object.account.id = $data["$target_id"]
                    $object.account.dn = $data["$target_dn"]
                else
                    $alert.context = join(["target privileges", $data["$target_dn"]], ": ")
                endif
            else
                $alert.context = join(["count of target accounts", $numfield1], ": ")
            endif

            $labels = join([$labels, "CheckWL_Windows_Login"], "|")
        endif

        if not in_list($target_services, lower(logon_service)) then
            $target_services = append($target_services, lower(logon_service))
        endif

        $count.subevents = $count.subevents + 1
    }

    on DMSA_Remove_Quickly {
        $subject = subject  # account
        $action = action    # remove
        $object = object    # ds_object
        $status = status    # success

        copy_fields($subject.account, subject.account)

        $object.name = object.name
        $object.fullpath = object.fullpath
        $object.type = object.type

        copy_fields($event_src, event_src)

        $reason = "removed quickly"

        $alert.key = lower(join([subject.account.name, object.fullpath], "|"))
        $alert.context = join(["dMSA removed", div(datetime_to_epoch(time) - datetime_to_epoch(select_query_first("Check_DMSA", [lower(object.fullpath)], "_last_changed")), 60), "minutes after modification"], " ")

        $labels = join([$labels, "CheckWL_Specific_Only"], "|")

        $count.subevents = $count.subevents + 1
    }


emit {
    $correlation_type = "incident"

    $importance = "high"

    if length($target_services) != 0 then
        $datafield1 = join($target_services, ", ")

        $alert.context = join([$alert.context, "target services: " + $datafield1], " | ")
    endif

    $category.generic = "Attack"
    $category.high = "Privilege Escalation"
    $category.low = "Account Manipulation"

    $incident.aggregation.key = join([$correlation_name, lower($event_src.host), lower($subject.account.name)], "|")
    $incident.severity = $importance
    $incident.category = "PermissionViolation"
    $incident.aggregation.timeout = 2h
}","description":""}

        and msgid == "1200"
        and lower(datafield2) == "intranet"
        and subject.account.name != null

            coalesce(lower(dst.host), lower(event_src.host)),
            lower(datafield7), # dst_path

        and filter::CheckWL_Profiling("ADFS_Abnormal_Access", lower(join([src.host, subject.account.name,
        event_src.host, event_src.subsys], "|")))
